claims.location: experimental design and exact RAW mapping
claims.value: Three Orbitrap Fusion Lumos reaction-mixture acquisitions: rPtxS1 alone, rPtxS1 plus NAD+, and rPtxS1 plus recombinant human G-alpha-i plus NAD+.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol, complete deposited file inventory, and accession-linked primary record; 3 of 3 RAW basenames covered exactly once.

limitations: The samples are purified recombinant reaction mixtures rather than intact biological specimens; organism and organism part are therefore not applicable at the sample level.
The mixed rPtxS1/G-alpha-i reaction contains proteins originating from two organisms, retained explicitly in the reaction-condition value instead of broadcasting one organism to the whole row.
The product-dependent method contains scouting HCD plus triggered second-HCD/EThcD scans; the single-valued SDRF dissociation field records the distinctive combined EThcD method.
